newsitem.title: SPAIN: SOCCER-ESPANYOL BACK COACH AFTER OFFER OF RESIGNATION.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-ESPANYOL BACK COACH AFTER OFFER OF RESIGNATION.

text.p: The board of struggling Espanyol on Monday gave their backing to Pepe Carcelen after the coach had offered to resign following Sunday's league defeat by Compostela.
But Espanyol vice-president Jose Manuel Lara warned that the club would take "appropriate measures" if the team lost again in their Spanish Cup tie against Sporting Gijon on Wednesday.
Espanyol have slumped to 15th after a championship campaign in which they qualified for the UEFA Cup as well as reaching the domestic Cup semifinals.
Former deputy coach Carcelen took over in the close season from Jose Antonio Camacho, who has fared even worse since moving to Sevilla.
